news.title: Indosolar Limited Announces CEO Changes, Effective January 16, 2026
news.body: Indosolar Limited at its board meeting held on January 16, 2026 took note of the resignation of Amit Ashok Paithankar as Chief Executive Officer of the Company, with effect from closure of business on January 16, 2026. Further, approved the appointment of Dr. Jignesh Devchandbhai Rathod as Chief Executive Officer of the Company with effect from January 16, 2026. Term of Appointment: Office is liable to retire by rotation. Dr. Jignesh Rathod is a senior business leader at Waaree Energies Limited, currently serving as Director ­Operations and designated to assume the role of Chief Executive Officer (CEO).
